notablePrerequisites: There are at least eight lands between the battlefield under your control and your hand, four or which enter untapped and can tap to produce at least {4}.
description:
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} plus commander tax if applicable, putting all land cards from your hand onto the battlefield, and then discarding Multani to return Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
When the lands enter, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered this way.
Activate at least four lands that enter untapped by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Multani's ability by paying {1}{G} and returning two lands to your hand.
Repeat step 4 at least once, and more times if desired.
Resolve all Multani abilities, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
